userStories.title: Remove dead 'reviewer' member from AnySentinelSource union
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the unreachable 'reviewer' member removed from the AnySentinelSource union so that the type reflects the only two sources parseAnySentinel actually produces ('implementer' | 'review-tag') and no dead type surface lingers.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'reviewer' member is removed from the AnySentinelSource union in src/supervisor/result.ts (~line 371), leaving exactly 'implementer' | 'review-tag'. [oracle: grep -Eq "export type AnySentinelSource = 'implementer' \| 'review-tag';" src/supervisor/result.ts]

No producer or consumer of AnySentinelSource references a 'reviewer' source: parseAnySentinel returns only 'implementer' or 'review-tag', and no `.source === 'reviewer'` branch exists. [oracle: test ! "$(grep -rn "source === 'reviewer'" src/)"]

The unrelated 'reviewer' usages are NOT touched: the per-phase model/config name (src/config/models.ts, src/commands/config.ts, src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx) and the tmux @cam_label pane label (src/tmux/session.ts, src/supervisor/loop.ts) remain. [oracle: grep -q "'@cam_label', 'reviewer'" src/supervisor/loop.ts]
No behavior change: parseAnySentinel detection logic and all other runtime code are unchanged (only the union type and an optional comment touch-up). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file change: src/supervisor/result.ts line 371. Delete the '| reviewer' segment of the AnySentinelSource union so it reads `'implementer' | 'review-tag'`. parseAnySentinel (result.ts:391) already returns only 'implementer' or 'review-tag' since CAM-233/US-003 removed the reviewer producer; its docstring already lists just those two, so no docstring change is required but a light comment touch-up is fine. GOTCHA: 'reviewer' is overloaded, it is ALSO a per-phase model-config name (src/config/models.ts, src/commands/config.ts, src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx) and a tmux @cam_label pane label (src/tmux/session.ts, src/supervisor/loop.ts:1427, src/supervisor/review.ts:418) -- those are different concepts, do NOT touch them. There is no exhaustiveness switch on AnySentinelSource anywhere, so no consumer case needs removing.
